about: Feedback elements that exist in the catalogue and that no component of the PRODUCT reads: nothing reads them at all, or only a component that /playground mounts does ("playground only"). Read by scripts/check-element-roster.mjs as DORMANT; written by scripts/pulse-variants.mjs, never by hand. One reason per element: it tells a reviewer whether the entry is a gap to close or a row to delete, and it is a promise that the studio labels the element as inert. The gate fails on such an element that is not listed here, and on an entry whose element a product component reads.
